snippet.title: VR2: Vacate 2 Rooms (GameplayTrailer)
snippet.description:
Get it on Steam:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/595300/VR2_Vacate_2_Rooms

VR2: Vacate 2 Rooms is an Escape the Room game. It's the next experience after VR: Vacate the Room.

Can you find your way out of the different rooms?

You need to find a lot of hidden items. Uncover secrets. Use strange mechanisms to proceed through the different rooms to the exit.

There is also a secret ending ...

You like the Song? Get it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/930180/VR2_Vacate_2_Rooms__Extras
